name: prized
description: Give Codex computers in the cloud: it puts your project on a Prized box, a Linux machine that stays on, and keeps working there with your laptop closed, and it runs code, tests and agents in Prized Sandboxes, microVMs that start in seconds.

interface.longDescription: Give Codex computers in the cloud: it puts your project on a Prized box, a Linux machine that stays on, and keeps working there with your laptop closed, and it runs code, tests and agents in Prized Sandboxes, microVMs that start in seconds.
defaultPrompt: Put this project on a Prized box and run its tests there.
Have Codex fix the failing tests on my Prized box while my laptop is closed.
Run this project's tests in 4 Prized sandboxes in parallel.

publication.release_notes: First release, with two skills. prized-boxes has Codex create a Prized box, copy the project to it once, run long jobs and Codex tasks there, and check on, pause, resume and resize the box. prized-sandboxes has Codex run commands, tests and agents in Prized Sandboxes, one or many in parallel, and delete them when the job is done.
